# Prose hygiene (Alex G)

A checklist for removing AI writing tells, with a scoring rubric for reviews.

- Source: https://github.com/hex/claude-sessions
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hex/claude-sessions/main/skills/prose-hygiene/SKILL.md
- Author: Alex G
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/prose-hygiene-alex-g-74e68bdd

Lists phrases and structures to avoid, such as throat-clearing openers, emphasis crutches, business jargon, adverbs, binary contrasts and formulaic setups, with plain replacements. When drafting, Claude avoids them; when reviewing, it quotes each match, names the rule and proposes a rewrite, then scores the text without editing the file. It includes carve-outs for technical writing. The taxonomy is adapted from the MIT-licensed stop-slop project.

**Try asking:**
- "Review this blog post for AI writing tells and score it"
- "Draft the summary of today's session without filler phrases"
- "Check this README intro against the prose hygiene rules"

**Source:** [hex/claude-sessions](https://github.com/hex/claude-sessions/tree/HEAD/skills/prose-hygiene) · MIT · by Alex G
